text:
mike: Quick sanity check following the handoff RFC. We saw a stale read in prod during demote+evict. Posting a short timeline and proposed safety paths.

tara: timeline please.

mike: timeline:
1) owner O1 starts demote (epoch=210)
2) a write W is accepted by O1 but is still inflight in memory
3) slab reclaim forces eviction of the prefix on O1; demote completes
4) owner O2 takes epoch=211 and serves a read; client observed pre-W state (stale)

lee: so demote can hand off ownership while unflushed inflight writes are only in RAM on O1. Bad.

sasha: three options: block demote until inflight writes drain; publish a lightweight fence/digest to control-plane; or make reads detect epoch bumps and consult old owner.

tara: detecting on reads is fragile under crash/partition. I'm leaning to fence+soft-pin as a primary solution.

mike: proposal sketch: on demote, O1 computes pending_digest D, publishes publish_fence(prefix, epoch, D) to control-plane (cheap metadata write), best-effort flush to local staging, and sets a soft-pin to delay immediate eviction. O2 on takeover will wait up to T_handshake for fence(D); if not seen, O2 calls O1 via RPC to reconcile; if O1 unreachable, O2 stalls reads (safety-first).

sasha: publish_fence must be idempotent and observable cluster-wide. We need to document durability modes: soft (metadata only), durable (metadata + staging flush), strict (metadata + WAL). Tenants can pick tradeoffs.

lee: soft-pin memory cost noted. Prior canary showed ~3% memory increase under churn. Add a canary flag to gate the soft-pin.

mike: telemetry/actionables: add counters for fence_publish, fence_seen, reconcile_rpc, crash_fallback; histograms for fence_latency and handoff_latency; emit handoff_trace_id for tracing.

tara: crash cases: if O1 crashes after fence publish but before flush, O2 may see fence but no data. So fence must either imply staging persisted or O2 must trigger read-repair. For first rollout, stall+repair is acceptable.

sasha: test plan: chaos scenario - demote while slab reclaim and node crash interleave, with slow writes. Validate no stale reads. Add to CI as integration test (non-blocking).

mike: action items:
- mike: implement demote->publish_fence metadata + opt-in soft-pin + unit tests + chaos scenario (ETA: EOW)
- sasha: draft control-plane fence API (fields, idempotency, durability modes) (ETA: 3d)
- lee: add telemetry and canary flag + dashboard (ETA: 2d)
- tara: update runbook with crash-fallback decision tree (ETA: 1d)

opsbot: created ticket IR-9712: "demote-fence-softpin-protocol" and added test-case "demote-inflight-crash" to the backlog.

mike: I'll open the PR and link IR-9712. Blocking-by-default for strict tenants; opt-in relaxed modes for low-tier later.

lee: blocking-by-default OK for correctness. We can later expose relaxed modes.

sasha: agreed. prioritize correctness on first pass.

tara: :thumbsup:

mike: closing thread; will post PR link when ready.
